docs.summary: Fraction of triangles to keep, from 0 to 1. Ignored when [`TargetTriangleCount`](#api~Prowl.Vector.Geometry.SimplifyOptions~TargetTriangleCount) is set.

Number of triangles to stop at. Negative means use [`TargetRatio`](#api~Prowl.Vector.Geometry.SimplifyOptions~TargetRatio). A collapse removes two triangles, or one on a border, so the result can land one below.

Largest surface deviation allowed, in the mesh's own units, as estimated by the quadric of the vertex being collapsed. Collapses that would go past it are never taken, so the result can stop short of the target. Zero or less only allows collapses that keep the surface exactly in place.
Keeps open borders exactly where they are, for shells and alpha cards.

Cost of changing each loop or vertex attribute, by name. Float attributes cost their weighted squared difference, int attributes cost their weight whenever they differ. Attributes left out cost nothing to change, but their seams are still kept.

Loop attributes whose discontinuities are seams that must survive. Null means every loop attribute. Discontinuities in other attributes are not protected, but every corner still keeps a value some original corner of its vertex had.
Face attributes that split the surface into regions whose outlines are kept, like a material index. Null means every face attribute.
Optional vertex attribute, any vertex with a non zero value never moves.
